controls: beta=0 isotropic channel gives zero response
parallel axes retain a one-dimensional kernel

definitions.axisymmetric_channel: M(n,alpha,beta)=alpha I+beta n n^T for unit n and beta!=0
definitions.response_gram: G is the 3x3 Gram of L on the orthonormal skew basis E1,E2,E3

exclusions: No photon transport, weak residual, spacetime derivative, calibrated observation, or science claim
source_policy: Only exact C04 component symbols are made explicit; no provenance-only derivation or historical axis result is admitted.
targets: G_ij=sum_a <[M_a,E_i],[M_a,E_j]>F and ker G equals the common skew commutant
For one nonisotropic axisymmetric channel, [M(n),W]=0 iff W n=0; its skew-kernel is the one-dimensional rotation axis span(n).
For two nonparallel unit axes n1,n2 with beta1,beta2 nonzero, the common skew commutant is {0}, hence stacked Gram is positive definite and rank 3.
